bears.name: Chicago Bears
bears.summary: Jeffery Simmons dismissed concerns over a knee injury that limited him in practice, saying "like 99 problems, but this ain't one" and confirming he expects to play Sunday against the New Orleans Saints. The Bears, who are coming off their Week 10 bye, are also anticipating the return of running back Kyle Monangai after he missed five games with turf toe and a thumb injury.

lions.name: Detroit Lions
lions.summary: The Detroit Lions officially activated safety Kerby Joseph from injury and placed star pass rusher Aidan Hutchinson on injured reserve after he tore his ACL in Munich, ending his season. With Hutchinson sidelined, Detroit (7-2) is preparing rookie EDGE Ahmed Hassanein for a potential NFL debut as the team gears up to host the Tampa Bay Buccaneers in a key Week 11 matchup at Ford Field.

packers.name: Green Bay Packers
packers.summary: The Green Bay Packers released running back Pierre Strong Jr. on Thursday, with Micah Parsons' return from injury imminent, the Green Bay Packers trimmed their roster to 52 players, releasing running back Pierre Strong Jr.

vikings.name: Minnesota Vikings
vikings.summary: The Minnesota Vikings are gearing up for their Week 11 "Sunday Night Football" matchup against the San Francisco 49ers in Mexico City, with the 49ers and Vikings aiming to avoid altitude sickness during their contest at Estadio Azteca , and head coach Brian Flores planning to rotate defensive players to combat the high-altitude conditions. In other team news, wide receiver Jordan Addison needed thumb surgery, leaving Kirk Cousins without a top target for multiple weeks , though head coach Kevin O'Connell later shared positive updates indicating Addison would avoid being placed on injured reserve for now.
